content: is she become as a widow!

content.text: That she had in the days
to make the soul to come again
all the desirable of the eye
And he hath violently taken away
What thing shall I take to witness
to thee, that I may comfort
Surely against me is he turned;
me about, that I cannot get out:
make to return to my heart
If so be there may be
for the punishment of his sins?
To the roof of his mouth
For the punishment of the iniquity
it is become like a stick.
in that they could not but touch
carry thee captive for thy sins
on our necks are we persecuted
the crown of our head is fallen [† symbol is missing in 1611 text]
unto us, that we have sinned!
for wilt thou utterly reject us?
